soundness_flags.label: ass:hac-kernel / thm:cylinder-hac
soundness_flags.one_line: The stated condition permits, for example, a zero-off-origin window, whereas Newey--West's consistency result is for its Bartlett weighting scheme; this permitted window estimates only Gamma_0 and need not estimate the long-run covariance.

soundness_flags.label: ass:hac-bandwidth / thm:cylinder-hac
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited Newey--West condition uses its Bartlett estimator with bandwidth o(T^(1/4)); h_T=o(T^(1/2)) is a different condition and needs a beta-mixing HAC source and matching kernel hypotheses.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 704-705, HAC weighting definition and Theorem 2
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The Newey--West estimator uses Bartlett weights 1-j/(m+1) up to bandwidth m, with its stated consistency regime requiring m=o(T^(1/4)); it is not a theorem for every symmetric compact-support window.
The paper gives a bounded graph segment for ID in causal time-series graphs with latent confounders, where the bound depends on width and maximum lag.
CIDP is claimed sound and complete for conditional-effect identification from a finite PAG representing a Markov-equivalence class.
The paper distinguishes macro from micro SCG queries and proves do-calculus sound and complete for macro total effects.
The paper completely characterizes when causal queries are computable from lower levels of the causal hierarchy and gives graphical noncomputability characterizations.
The paper develops nested-Markov structure for ADMGs and uses fixing to characterize identifiable causal effects in hidden-variable DAG models.
The paper derives influence-function estimators and a complete identification algorithm yielding weight-based estimation strategies for identifiable hidden-variable effects.
The paper develops synthetic-control treatment inference and establishes asymptotic size control for stationary beta-mixing processes.
The paper gives necessary and sufficient conditions complete for adjustment in summary causal graphs of time series, with a pseudo-linear decision algorithm.
EasyRCA identifies remaining roots by comparing normal- and anomalous-regime direct effects through an adjustment set.
The paper reduces discrete causal questions to polynomial programs and computes sharp bounds through automated numerical optimization.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the HAC assumptions with either the exact Bartlett/Newey--West specification and its bandwidth regime, or cite and state a general beta-mixing HAC theorem with continuity-at-zero and summability conditions for K.
Add a worked non-front-door, latent-confounded summary instance that explicitly lists transducer states, one successful common cylinder functional, and one finite lag-switch certificate encoding.
Strengthen the extension comparison into a family separating TID-SCG from both Assaad's front-door criterion and common-adjustment completeness, rather than relying on one outside-front-door input.

recommended_next_step: Revise the HAC assumptions and theorem dependencies, then continue this angle to Stage 0; the identification kernel remains novel on both repo and published axes.
